mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate lower financing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS (3-month trend), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) indicates policy response to inflation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate rate cuts.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of such cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0% and increasing 3-month trend), labor market deterioration signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals strong housing market activity, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising HOUST (3-month trend), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates manufacturing slowdown reducing corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust demand expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate higher corporate revenues.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when HOUST and RSAFS both rise but SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of such cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and rising labor force participation (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), the tight labor market fuels wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03.
